dn25:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
dn25:1.3: tena kho pana samayena nigrodho paribbājako udumbarikāya paribbājakārāme paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ tiṃsamattehi paribbājakasatehi.
dn25:1.4: atha kho sandhāno gahapati divā divassa rājagahā nikkhami bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
dn25:1.10: yannūnāhaṃ yena udumbarikāya paribbājakārāmo yena nigrodho paribbājako tenupasaṅkameyyanti.
dn25:1.11: atha kho sandhāno gahapati yena udumbarikāya paribbājakārāmo yena nigrodho paribbājako tenupasaṅkami.
dn25:2.1: tena kho pana samayena nigrodho paribbājako mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ nisinno hoti unnādiniyā uccāsaddamahāsaddāya anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentiyā -
dn25:2.2: seyyathidaṃ: rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mahāmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ yānakathaṃ gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ purisakathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lokakkhāyikaṃ samuddakkhāyikaṃ itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā.
dn25:3.1: addasā kho nigrodho paribbājako sandhānaṃ gahapatiṃ dūrato’va āgacchantaṃ.
dn25:3.3: appasaddā bhonto hontu, mā bhonto saddamakattha.
dn25:3.4: ayaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako āgacchati sandhāno gahapati.
dn25:3.5: yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā rājagahe paṭivasanti, ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro sandhāno gahapati.
dn25:3.6: appasaddakāmā kho panete āyasmanto appasaddavinītā appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino.
dn25:3.7: appevanāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyā ti.
dn25:3.8: evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
dn25:4.1: atha kho sandhāno gahapati yena nigrodho paribbājako tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā nigrodhena paribbājakena saddhiṃ sammodi,
dn25:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sandhāno gahapati nigrodhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca:
dn25:4.3: aññathā kho ime bhonto aññatitthiyā paribbājakā saṃgamma samāgamma unnādino uccāsaddamahāsaddā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ iti vā anuyuttā viharanti -
dn25:4.5: aññathā kho pana so bhagavā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppānī’ti.
dn25:5.1: evaṃ vutte nigrodho paribbājako sandhānaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
dn25:5.2: yagghe gahapati jāneyyāsi, kena samaṇo gotamo saddhiṃ sallapati? kena sākacchaṃ samāpajjati? kena paññāveyyattiyaṃ āpajjati.
dn25:5.3: suññāgārahatā samaṇassa gotamassa paññā, aparisāvacaro samaṇo gotamo, nālaṃ sallāpāya.
dn25:5.5: seyyathāpi nāma go kāṇā pariyantacārinī antamantāneva sevati.
dn25:5.10: iṅgha gahapati, samaṇo gotamo imaṃ parisaṃ āgaccheyya, ekapañheneva naṃ saṃsādeyyāma, tucchakumbhīva naṃ maññe orodheyyāmā’ti.
dn25:6.1: assosi kho bhagavā dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya sandhānassa gahapatissa nigrodhena paribbājakena saddhiṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
dn25:6.2: atha kho bhagavā gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohitvā yena sumāgadhāya tīre moranivāpo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā sumāgadhāya tīre moranivāpe abbhokāse caṅkami.
dn25:6.3: addasā kho nigrodho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ sumāgadhāya tīre moranivāpe abbhokāse caṅkamantaṃ.
dn25:6.5: appasaddā bhonto hontu, mā bhonto saddamakattha, ayaṃ samaṇo gotamo sumāgadhāya tīre moranivāpe abbhokāse caṅkamati.
dn25:6.6: appasaddakāmo kho pana so āyasmā, appasaddassa vaṇṇavādī.
dn25:6.7: appevanāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyya.
dn25:6.8: sace samaṇo gotamo imaṃ parisaṃ āgaccheyya, imaṃ taṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyāma
dn25:6.9: ‘ko nāma so bhante bhagavato dhammo yena bhagavā sāvake vineti, yena bhagavatā sāvakā vinītā assāsappattā paṭijānanti ajjhāsayaṃ ādibrahmacariyanti?
dn25:6.10: evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
dn25:7.1: atha kho bhagavā yena nigrodho paribbājako tenupasaṅkami.
dn25:7.2: atha kho nigrodho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn25:7.3: etu kho bhante bhagavā, svāgataṃ bhante bhagavato.
dn25:7.4: cirassaṃ kho bhante bhagavā imaṃ pariyāyamakāsi yadidaṃ idhāgamanāya.
dn25:7.7: nigrodho pi kho paribbājako aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn25:7.8: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho nigrodhaṃ paribbājakaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
dn25:7.9: ‘kāyanuttha nigrodha etarahi kathāya sannisinnā? kā ca pana vo antarā kathā vippakatā?ti.
dn25:7.10: evaṃ vutte nigrodho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn25:7.11: “idha mayaṃ bhante addasāma bhagavantaṃ sumāgadhāya tīre moranivāpe abbhokāse caṅkamantaṃ. disvāna evaṃ avocumhā:
dn25:7.12: sace samaṇo gotamo imaṃ parisaṃ āgaccheyya, imaṃ taṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyāma:
dn25:7.13: ko nāma so bhante bhagavato dhammo yena bhagavā sāvake vineti, yena bhagavatā sāvakā vinītā assāsappattā paṭijānanti ajjhāsayaṃ ādibrahmacariyanti?”
dn25:7.14: ayaṃ kho no bhante antarā kathā vippakatā, atha bhagavā anuppatto”ti.
dn25:7.15: “dujjānaṃ kho panetaṃ nigrodha, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucike aññatrāyogena aññatrācariyakena ‘yenāhaṃ sāvake vinemi, yena mayā sāvakā vinītā assāsappattā paṭijānanti ajjhāsayaṃ ādibrahmacariyanti.
dn25:7.16: iṅgha tvaṃ maṃ nigrodha sake ācariyake adhijegucche pañhaṃ puccha
dn25:7.17: “kathaṃ santā nu kho bhante tapojigucchā paripuṇṇā hoti, kathaṃ aparipuṇṇā”?ti.
dn25:7.18: evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā unnādino uccāsaddā mahāsaddā ahesuṃ,
dn25:7.19: “acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho samaṇassa gotamassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā, yatra hi nāma sakavādaṃ ṭhapessati, paravādena pavāressatī”ti.
dn25:8.1: atha kho nigrodho paribbājako te paribbājake appasadde katvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn25:8.2: “mayaṃ kho bhante tapojigucchāvādā tapojigucchāsārā tapojigucchaṃ allīnā viharāma.
dn25:8.3: kathaṃ santā nu kho bhante tapojigucchā paripuṇṇā hoti, kathaṃ aparipuṇṇā?ti”
dn25:8.4: “idha nigrodha tapassī acelako hoti, muttācāro hatthāpalekhano, na ehibhadantiko, na tiṭṭhabhadantiko, nābhihaṭaṃ na uddissakaṭaṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyati.
dn25:8.5: so na kumbhimukhā paṭigaṇhāti, na kaḷopimukhā paṭigaṇhāti. na eḷakamantaraṃ, na daṇḍamantaraṃ, na musalamantaraṃ, na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, na gabbhiniyā, na pāyamānāya, na purisantaragatāya, na saṃkittīsu, na yattha sā uṭṭhito hoti, na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ, na maṃsaṃ, na suraṃ, na merayaṃ, na thusodakaṃ pivati.
dn25:8.6: so ekāgāriko vā hoti ekālopiko, dvāgāriko vā hoti dvā lopiko, sattāgāriko vā hoti sattālopiko, ekissāpi dattiyā yāpeti, dvīhi pi dattīhi yāpeti …pe… sattahi pi dattīhi yāpeti.
dn25:8.7: ekāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti, dvāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti tīhikampi … catūhikampi … pañcāhikampi … chāhikampi … sattāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti …pe… iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikampi pariyāyabhattabhojanānuyogamanuyutto viharati.
dn25:8.8: so sākabhakkho vā hoti, sāmākabhakkho vā hoti, nīvārabhakkho vā hoti, daddulabhakkho vā hoti, haṭabhakkho vā hoti, kaṇabhakkho vā hoti, ācāmabhakkho vā hoti, piññākabhakkho vā hoti, tiṇabhakkho vā hoti, gomayabhakkho vā hoti, vanamūlaphalāhāro yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.
dn25:8.9: so sāṇāni pi dhāreti, masāṇāni pi dhāreti, chavadussāni pi dhāreti, paṃsukūlāni pi dhāreti, tirīṭāni pi dhāreti, ajināni pi dhāreti, ajinakkhipampi dhāreti, kusacīrampi dhāreti, vākacīrampi dhāreti, phalakacīrampi dhāreti, kesakambalampi dhāreti, vāḷakambalampi dhāreti, ulūkapakkhampi dhāreti.
dn25:8.13: kaṇṭakāpassayiko pi hoti kaṇṭakāpasse seyyaṃ kappeti,
dn25:8.23: yadi evaṃ sante tapojigucchā paripuṇṇā vā hoti aparipuṇṇā vā?ti.
dn25:8.24: addhā kho bhante, evaṃ sante tapojigucchā paripuṇṇā hoti no aparipuṇṇā”ti.
dn25:8.25: tapo upakkilesā “evaṃ paripuṇṇāya pi kho ahaṃ nigrodha, tapojigucchāya anekavihite upakkilese vadāmī”ti.
dn25:9.1: “yathākathaṃ pana bhante bhagavā evaṃ paripuṇṇāya tapojigucchāya anekavihite upakkilese vadatī?ti.”
dn25:9.2: “idha nigrodha tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. so tena tapasā attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṃkappo.
dn25:9.3: yampi nigrodha tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṃkappo.
dn25:9.4: ayampi kho nigrodha tapassino upakkileso’ hoti.
dn25:9.5: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. so tena tapasā attānukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.
dn25:9.6: yampi nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. so tena tapasā attānukkaṃseti. paraṃ vambheti.
dn25:9.8: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. so tena tapasā majjati mucchati pamādamāpajjati.
dn25:9.9: yampi nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā majjati mucchati pamādamāpajjati,
dn25:9.10: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:10.1: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. so tena tapasā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti. so tena lābhasakkārasilokena attamāno hoti paripuṇṇasaṃkappo.
dn25:10.2: yampi nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti, so tena lābhasakkārasilokena attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṃkappo.
dn25:10.3: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:10.4: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. so tena tapasā lābhasakkāra silokaṃ abhinibbatteti. so tena lābhasakkārasilokena attānukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.
dn25:10.5: yampi nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti, so tena lābhasakkārasilokena attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
dn25:10.6: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:10.7: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. so tena tapasā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti. so tena lābhasakkārasilokena majjati mucchati pamādamāpajjati.
dn25:10.8: yampi kho nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti, so tena lābhasakkārasilokena majjati mucchati pamādamāpajjati.
dn25:10.9: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:10.10: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, bhojanesu vodāsaṃ āpajjati
dn25:10.12: so yañca khvassa nakkhamati taṃ sāpekkho pajahati,
dn25:10.13: yaṃ panassa khamati taṃ gathito mucchito ajjhopanno anādīnavadassāvī anissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati …pe…
dn25:10.14: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:10.15: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati lābhasakkārasilokanikantihetu
dn25:10.16: ‘sakkarissanti maṃ rājāno rājamahāmattā khattiyā brāhmaṇā gahapatikā titthiyā’ti. …pe…
dn25:10.17: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:11.1: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī aññataraṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā apasādetā hoti:
dn25:11.3: seyyathidaṃ mūlabījaṃ khandhabījaṃ phaḷubījaṃ aggabījaṃ bījabījameva pañcamaṃ asanivicakkaṃ dantakūṭaṃ samaṇappavādenāti …pe…
dn25:11.4: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:11.5: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī passati aññataraṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā kulesu sakkarīyamānaṃ garukarīyamānaṃ mānīyamānaṃ pūjīyamānaṃ
dn25:11.7: imañhi nāma sambahulājīvaṃ kulesu sakkaronti garu karonti mānenti pūjenti,
dn25:11.8: maṃ pana tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ kulesu na sakkaronti na garu karonti na mānenti na pūjentī’ti, iti so issāmacchariyaṃ kulesu uppādetā hoti …pe…
dn25:11.9: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:11.10: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī āpātakanisādī hoti. yampi kho nigrodha, tapassi āpātakanisādī hoti
dn25:11.11: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:11.12: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī attānaṃ ādassayamāno kulesu carati
dn25:11.13: idampi me tapasmiṃ idampi me tapasminti. …pe…
dn25:11.14: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:11.15: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī kiñcideva paṭicchannaṃ sevati
dn25:11.16: so ‘khamati te idanti?’ puṭṭho samāno akkhamamānaṃ āha ‘khamatī’ti
dn25:11.19: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:12.1: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tathāgatassa santaññeva pariyāyaṃ anuññeyyaṃ nānujānāti …pe…
dn25:12.2: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:12.3: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī kodhano hoti upanāhī.
dn25:12.4: yampi nigrodha, tapassī kodhano hoti upanāhī,
dn25:12.5: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:12.6: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī makkhī hoti. paḷāsī …pe…
dn25:12.10: pāpiccho hoti pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato …pe…
dn25:12.13: yampi nigrodha, tapassī sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī,
dn25:12.14: ayampi kho nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
dn25:12.16: yadi me tapojigucchā upakkilesā vā anupakkilesā vā?ti.
dn25:12.17: “addhā kho ime bhante, tapojigucchā upakkilesā no anupakkilesā,
dn25:12.18: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ bhante vijjati, yaṃ idhekacco tapassī sabbeheva imehi upakkilesehi samannāgato assa,
dn25:13.1: idha nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā na attamano hoti na paripuṇṇasaṃkappo.
dn25:13.2: yampi nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā na attamano hoti na paripuṇṇasaṃkappo.
dn25:13.3: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:13.4: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. so tena tapasā na attānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti. yampi nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā na attānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
dn25:13.5: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:13.6: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. so tena tapasā na majjati na mucchati na pamādamāpajjati. yampi nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. so tena tapasā na majjati na mucchati na pamādamāpajjati.
dn25:13.7: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:13.8: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. so tena tapasā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti. so tena lābhasakkārasilokena na attamano hoti na paripuṇṇasaṃkappo. yampi nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati so tena tapasā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti. so tena lābhasakkārasilokena na attamano hoti na paripuṇṇasaṃkappo.
dn25:13.9: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:13.10: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. so tena tapasā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti. so tena lābhasakkārasilokena na attānukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti. yampi nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati so tena tapasā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti. so tena lābhasakkārasilokena na attānukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
dn25:13.11: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:13.12: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. so tena tapasā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti. so tena lābhasakkārasilokena na majjati na mucchati na pamādamāpajjati. yampi nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati so tena tapasā lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti. so tena lābhasakkārasilokena na majjati na mucchati na pamādamāpajjati.
dn25:13.13: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:13.14: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati. bhojanesu na vodāsaṃ āpajjati
dn25:13.16: so yañca khvassa nakkhamati taṃ anapekkho pajahati,
dn25:13.17: yaṃ panassa khamati taṃ agathito amucchito anajjhopanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati.
dn25:13.18: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:13.19: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī na tapaṃ samādiyati, lābhasakkārasilokanikantihetu
dn25:13.20: ‘sakkarissanti maṃ rājāno rājamahāmattā khattiyā brāhmaṇā gahapatikā titthiyā’ti.
dn25:13.21: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:13.22: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī aññataraṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā nāpasāretā hoti:
dn25:13.24: seyyathidaṃ, mūlabījaṃ khandhabījaṃ phaḷubījaṃ aggabījaṃ bījabījameva pañcamaṃ, asanivicakkaṃ dantakūṭaṃ samaṇappavādenāti,
dn25:13.25: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:14.1: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī passati aññataraṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā kulesu sakkarīyamānaṃ garukarīyamānaṃ mānīyamānaṃ pūjīyamānaṃ.
dn25:14.3: imañhi nāma sambahulājīviṃ kulesu sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjenti.
dn25:14.4: maṃ pana tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ kulesu na sakkaronti na garukaronti na mānenti na pūjentīti, iti so issāmacchariyaṃ kulesu anuppādetā hoti,
dn25:14.5: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:14.6: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī na āpātakanisādī hoti
dn25:14.7: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:14.8: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī na attānaṃ adassayamāno kulesu carati
dn25:14.10: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:14.11: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī na kiñcideva paṭicchannaṃ sevati, so
dn25:14.12: ‘khamati te idanti?’ puṭṭho samāno akkhamamānaṃ āha
dn25:14.16: iti so sampajānamusā na bhāsitā hoti.
dn25:14.17: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:15.1: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā dhammaṃ desentassa santaṃ yeva pariyāyaṃ anuññeyyaṃ anujānāti,
dn25:15.2: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:15.3: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī akkodhano hoti anupanāhī.
dn25:15.4: yampi nigrodha, tapassī akkodhano hoti anupanāhī, evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:15.5: puna caparaṃ nigrodha, tapassī amakkhī hoti apalāsī …pe…
dn25:15.9: na pāpiccho hoti na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato,
dn25:15.10: na micchādiṭṭhiko hoti na antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato …pe…
dn25:15.11: na sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti na ādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī.
dn25:15.12: yampi nigrodha, tapassī na sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti na ādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī,
dn25:15.13: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
dn25:15.15: yadi evaṃ sante tapojigucchā parisuddhā vā hoti aparisuddhā vā?ti”
dn25:15.16: addhā kho bhante, evaṃ sante tapojigucchā parisuddhā hoti no aparisuddhā, aggappattā ca sārappattā cā”ti.
dn25:15.17: “na kho nigrodha, ettāvatā tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā ca.
dn25:15.18: api ca kho papaṭikappattā va hotī”ti. parisuddhatvappattakatā - kathā
dn25:16.1: “kittāvatā pana bhante, tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā ca.
dn25:16.2: sādhu me bhante bhagavā tapojigucchāya aggaññeva pāpetu, sāraññeva pāpetū”ti.
dn25:16.5: idha nigrodha, tapassī na pāṇamatipāteti, na pāṇamatipātāpayati, na pāṇamatipātayato samanuñño hoti,
dn25:16.6: na adinnaṃ ādiyati, na adinnaṃ ādiyāpeti, na adinnaṃ ādiyato samanuñño hoti,
dn25:16.7: na musā bhaṇati, na musā bhaṇāpeti, na musā bhaṇato samanuñño hoti,
dn25:16.8: na bhāvitamāsiṃsati, na bhāvitamāsiṃsāpeti, na bhāvitamāsiṃsato samanuñño hoti.
dn25:16.9: evaṃ kho nigrodha, tapassī cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto hoti,
dn25:16.10: yato kho nigrodha, tapassī cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto hoti, aduṃ cassa hoti tapassitāya.
dn25:16.12: so vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
dn25:16.13: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya, parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
dn25:16.14: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati, abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn25:16.16: thinamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathinamiddho viharati, ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thinamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn25:16.17: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati, ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn25:16.18: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati, akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu, vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn25:17.1: so ime pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe,
dn25:17.2: mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
dn25:17.5: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
dn25:17.7: yadi evaṃ sante tapojigucchā parisuddhā vā hoti. no aparisuddhā.
dn25:17.8: “addhā kho bhante, evaṃ sante tapojigucchā parisuddhā hoti no aparisuddhā, aggappattā ca sārappattā’cā”ti.
dn25:17.9: “na kho nigrodha, ettāvatā tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā ca,
dn25:17.10: api ca kho tacappattā hotī”ti. parisuddhapheggupattakatā - kathā
dn25:18.1: “kittāvatā ca kho pana bhante, tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā ca?
dn25:18.2: sādhu me bhante bhagavā tapojigucchāya aggaññeva pāpetu sāraññeva pāpetū”ti.
dn25:18.4: kathañca pana nigrodha tapassī cātuyāma saṃvarasaṃvuto hoti. …pe…
dn25:18.5: yato kho nigrodha, tapassī evaṃ cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto hoti aduṃ cassa hoti tapassitāya.
dn25:18.8: so ime pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
dn25:18.13: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathidaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dve’pi jātiyo tisso’pi jātiyo catasso’pi jātiyo pañca’pi jātiyo dasa’pi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattāḷīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi, anekāni’pi jātisatāni anekāni’pi jātisahassāni anekāni’pi jātisatasahassāni, aneke’pi saṃvaṭṭakappe aneke’pi vivaṭṭakappe aneke’pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe: amutrāsiṃ evannāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ. tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto idhūpapanno”ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
dn25:18.15: yadi evaṃ sante tapojigucchā parisuddhā vā hoti aparisuddhā vā?”ti.
dn25:18.16: “addhā kho bhante, evaṃ sante tapojigucchā parisuddhā hoti no aparisuddhā, aggappattā ca sārappattā cā”ti.
dn25:18.17: “na kho nigrodha, ettāvatā tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā ca.
dn25:18.18: api ca kho phegguppattā hotī”ti. parisuddha aggappattasārappattakatā - kathā
dn25:19.1: “kittāvatā pana bhante, tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā ca?
dn25:19.2: sādhu me bhante bhagavā tapojigucchāya aggaññeva pāpetu sāraññeva pāpetū”ti.
dn25:19.5: yato kho nigrodha, tapassī cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto hoti, aduṃ cassa hoti tapassitāya.
dn25:19.8: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe,
dn25:19.10: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
dn25:19.11: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati. seyyathidaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
dn25:19.12: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti “ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā, ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā. te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā”ti.
dn25:19.14: yadi evaṃ sante tapojigucchā parisuddhā vā hoti aparisuddhā vā?”ti.
dn25:19.15: “addhā kho bhante, evaṃ sante tapojigucchā parisuddhā hoti, no aparisuddhā, aggappattā ca sārappattā cā”ti.
dn25:19.16: “ettāvatā kho nigrodha, tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā ca.
dn25:19.17: iti kho nigrodha, yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ avacāsi:
dn25:19.18: ko nāma so bhante bhagavato dhammo yena bhagavā sāvake vineti, yena bhagavatā sāvakā vinītā assāsappattā paṭijānanti ajjhāsayaṃ ādibrahmacariyanti.
dn25:19.19: iti kho taṃ nigrodha, ṭhānaṃ uttaritarañca paṇītatarañca yenāhaṃ sāvake vinemi, yena mayā sāvakā vinītā assāsappattā paṭijānanti ajjhāsayaṃ ādibrahmacariyanti”.
dn25:19.20: evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā unnādino uccāsaddamahāsaddā ahesuṃ
dn25:19.21: “ettha mayaṃ anassāma sācariyakā, ettha mayaṃ panassāma sācariyakā na mayaṃ ito bhiyyo uttaritaraṃ pajānāmā”ti. nigrodhassa pajjhāyanaṃ
dn25:20.2: ‘aññadatthu kho’ dānime aññatitthiyā paribbājakā bhagavato bhāsitaṃ sussūsanti, sotaṃ odahanti, aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhapentī’ti.
dn25:20.4: iti kho bhante nigrodha yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ avacāsi,
dn25:20.5: ‘yagghe gahapati jāneyyāsi kena samaṇo gotamo saddhiṃ sallapati? kena sākacchaṃ samāpajjati? kena paññāveyyattiyaṃ samāpajjati?
dn25:20.6: suññāgārahatā samaṇassa gotamassa paññā, aparisāvacaro samaṇo gotamo, nālaṃ sallāpāya, so antamantāneva sevati,
dn25:20.7: seyyathāpi nāma go kāṇā pariyantacārinī antamantāneva sevati.
dn25:20.8: evameva suññāgārahataṃ samaṇassa gotamassa paññā, aparisāvacaro samaṇo gotamo, nālaṃ sallāpāya, so antamantāneva sevati.
dn25:20.9: iṃgha ca gahapati samaṇo gotamo imaṃ parisaṃ āgaccheyya, ekapañheneva naṃ saṃsādeyyāma, tucchakumbhī’va naṃ maññe orodheyyāmā”ti.
dn25:20.10: ayaṃ kho so bhante bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho idhānuppatto. aparisāvacaraṃ pana naṃ karotha, gokāṇaṃ pariyantacāriniṃ karotha, ekapañheneva naṃ saṃsādetha, tucchakumbhī’va naṃ maññe orodhethā”ti.
dn25:20.11: “evaṃ vutte nigrodho paribbājako tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi.
dn25:21.1: atha kho bhagavā nigrodhaṃ paribbājakaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhānaṃ viditvā nigrodhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca;
dn25:21.2: “saccaṃ kira nigrodha bhāsitā te esā vācā”ti.
dn25:21.3: “saccaṃ bhante, bhāsitā me esā vācā yathā bālena yathā mūḷhena yathā akusalenā”ti.
dn25:21.5: kinti te sutaṃ paribbājakānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
dn25:21.6: ye te ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, evaṃ su te bhagavanto saṃgamma unnādino uccāsaddamahāsaddā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ anuyuttā vihariṃsu,
dn25:21.7: seyyathidaṃ rāja kathaṃ corakathaṃ …pe… itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā,
dn25:21.9: udāhu evaṃ su te bhagavanto araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhaseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni, seyyathāpāhaṃ etarahī?”ti.
dn25:21.10: “sutaṃ metaṃ bhante, paribbājakānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
dn25:21.11: ‘ye te ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, na evaṃ su te bhagavanto saṃgamma samāgamma unnādino uccāsaddamahāsaddā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ anuyuttā viharanti,
dn25:21.12: seyyathidaṃ rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ …pe… itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā,
dn25:21.14: evaṃ su te bhagavanto araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhaseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni seyyathāpi bhagavā etarahī”’ti.
dn25:21.15: “tassa te nigrodha, viññussa sato mahallakassa na etadahosi:
dn25:21.16: buddho so bhagavā bodhāya dhammaṃ deseti, danto so bhagavā damathāya dhammaṃ deseti, santo so bhagavā samathāya dhammaṃ deseti, tiṇṇo so bhagavā taraṇāya dhammaṃ deseti, parinibbuto so bhagavā parinibbānāya dhammaṃ desetī?”ti. brahmacariyapariyosāna-sacchikiriyā
dn25:22.2: “accayo me bhante accagamā yathā bālaṃ yathā mūḷhaṃ yathā akusalaṃ, svāhaṃ evaṃ bhagavantaṃ avacāsiṃ.
dn25:22.3: tassa me bhante bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭigaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā”ti.
dn25:22.4: “taggha tvaṃ nigrodha, accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathā mūḷhaṃ yathā akusalaṃ, yo maṃ tvaṃ evaṃ avacāsi.
dn25:22.5: yato ca kho tvaṃ nigrodha, accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi, tante mayaṃ paṭigaṇhāma,
dn25:22.6: vuddhi hesā nigrodha ariyassa vinaye, yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti, āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
dn25:22.7: ahaṃ kho pana nigrodha evaṃ vadāmi:
dn25:22.8: “etu viññū puriso asaṭho amāyāvī ujujātiko. ahamanusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi:
dn25:22.9: yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati satta vassāni.
dn25:22.11: etu viññū puriso asaṭho amāyāvī ujujātiko, ahamanusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
dn25:22.12: yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapavayosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati cha vassāni …pe…
dn25:22.19: etu viññū puriso asaṭho amāyāvī ujujātiko. ahamanusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
dn25:22.20: yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati satta māsāni.
dn25:22.30: etu viññū puriso asaṭho amāyāvī ujujātiko, ahamanusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi,
dn25:22.31: yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati sattāhaṃ. paribbājakānaṃ pajjhāyanaṃ
dn25:23.1: siyā kho pana te nigrodha evamassa:
dn25:23.2: antevāsikamyatā no samaṇo gotamo evamāhā ti.
dn25:23.3: na kho panetaṃ nigrodha evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ,
dn25:23.4: yo eva te ācariyo so eva te ācariyo hotu.
dn25:23.5: siyā kho pana te nigrodha evamassa:
dn25:23.6: uddesā no cāvetukāmo samaṇo gotamo evamāhā ti.
dn25:23.7: na kho panetaṃ nigrodha evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
dn25:23.8: yo eva te uddeso, so eva te uddeso hotu.
dn25:23.9: siyā kho pana te nigrodha evamassa:
dn25:23.10: ājīvā no cāvetukāmo samaṇo gotamo evamāhā ti.
dn25:23.11: na kho panetaṃ nigrodha evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
dn25:23.12: yo eva te ājīvo so eva te ājīvo hotu.
dn25:23.13: siyā kho pana te nigrodha evamassa:
dn25:23.14: ye no dhammā akusalā akusalasaṅkhātā sācariyakānaṃ, tesu patiṭṭhāpetukāmo samaṇo gotamo evamāhā ti.
dn25:23.15: na kho panetaṃ nigrodha evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ
dn25:23.16: akusalā ceva vo dhammā hontu akusalasaṅkhātā ca sācariyakānaṃ.
dn25:23.17: siyā kho pana te nigrodha evamassa:
dn25:23.18: ye no dhammā kusalā kusalasaṅkhātā sācariyakānaṃ, tehi vivecetukāmo samaṇo gotamo evamāhā ti.
dn25:23.19: na kho panetaṃ nigrodha evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ,
dn25:23.20: kusalā ceva vo dhammā hontu kusalasaṅkhātā ca sācariyakānaṃ.
dn25:23.21: iti khvāhaṃ nigrodha neva antevāsikamyatā evaṃ vadāmi, napi uddesā cāvetukāmo evaṃ vadāmi. napi ājīvā cāvetukāmo evaṃ vadāmi, napi ye ca vo dhammā akusalā akusalasaṅkhātā sācariyakānaṃ tesu patiṭṭhāpetukāmo evaṃ vadāmi. napi ye ca vo dhammā kusalā kusalasaṅkhātā sācariyakānaṃ tehi vivecetukāmo evaṃ vadāmi.
dn25:23.22: santi ca kho nigrodha akusalā dhammā appahīṇā saṃkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā, yesāhaṃ pahānāya dhammaṃ desemi.
dn25:23.23: yathā paṭipannānaṃ vo saṃkilesikā dhammā pahīyissanti, vodāniyā dhammā abhivaḍḍhissanti, paññāpāripūriṃ vepullattañca diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā”ti.
dn25:24.1: “evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā tuṇhībhūtā maṅkubhūtā pattakkhandhā adhomukhā pajjhāyantā appaṭibhānā nisīdiṃsu, yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacittā.
dn25:24.3: sabbe pi me moghapurisā phuṭṭhā pāpimatā.
dn25:24.4: yatra hi nāma ekassapi na evaṃ bhavissati
dn25:24.5: “handa mayaṃ aññāṇatthampi samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ carāma, kiṃ karissati sattāho”ti.
dn25:24.6: atha kho bhagavā udumbarikāya paribbājakārāme sīhanādaṃ naditvā, vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā, gijjhakūṭe pabbate paccuṭṭhāsi
dn25:24.7: sandhāno pana gahapati tāvadeva rājagahaṃ pāvisī ti.
